description: This Java class defines the ConceptName entity within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It models concept names with attributes such as locale, type, status (voided or not), associated tags, and metadata like creation and modification details. It includes methods for managing tags, checking name types (short, fully specified, synonym, index term), and localization preferences.

classes.name: ConceptName
classes.description: Represents a localized name for a medical or concept terminology within the OpenMRS system, supporting various name types, localization, tagging, and status attributes.
